paite: Zion ah pengkul mut unla, ka tang siangthou ah kigalginna puang un; hiai gamsung a mi tengteng ling uhen; TOUPA ni hong tung ding, anaita hi.
heading: Khaukhup A Gawtna Mulkimhuai
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of Yahweh comes, for it is close at hand:

paite: Mialna leh khonimna ni, mei kai ni leh mial sah ni, tangte tung a phalvak tangkhia bang a mipi tampitak leh hattak, huchibang om ngei nai lou, tunung a suan tampi tan a leng om nawn ngei sam lou ding ahong tung ding hi.
english: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.

paite: Amaban uh mei in akangsiang a; anunglam uh meikuang in ahul a; ama ua gam lah Eden huan bang ahi, anunglam ua gamdai gamkeu ahi a; ahi, bangmah in huai apel kei uh.
english: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.

paite: Alatdan uh sakol latdan bang ahi; sakol tungtuangmi bang in atai uhi.
english: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.

paite: Kidouna kangtalai ging bang in tang tung ah akilek suausuau ua, buhpawl kang kuang luahluah leh kidouna a mipi hattak mansa abang uhi.
english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.

paite: Amaute mu mipite alau ua; amelte uh ahong mual khin uhi.
english: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.

paite: Mihattak bang in atai ua; kidoumi bang in baang ah akah ua, amau zawn chiat ah apai ua, akivolhdan uh ahihbuai kei uhi.
english: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.

paite: Akiphu kha tuan kei ua; amau lampi ah apai chiat ua; galvante anawk paisuak ua, apialzak kei uh.
english: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.

paite: Khopi tung ah atawm ua; kulh tung ah atai ua; insungte ah akaltou ua; guta bang in tohlette ah alut uhi.
english: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.

paite: Ama uah lei aling a; vante aling hi; ni leh kha amial a, aksite'n avak uh asel uhi;
english: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N asepaihhonte ma ah a-aw asuah a; agiahbukte lah athupi ngal a; athu tangtungsakpa ahat a, TOUPA ni athupi in amulkimhuai ngal a, kua'n athuak thei mahmah dia?
english: Yahweh thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of Yahweh is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?

paite: TOUPA'N, huchipi in leng tu in na lungtang tengteng ua an ngawl a, kap a, lungkham in kei lam hong nga le uchin.
heading: Kisik A An Ngawl Ding A Chialna
english: “Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”

paite: Na puante uh hilou in na lungtang uh botkek unla, TOUPA na Pathian lam nga un; amah hehpih theitak leh lainatna a dim, lungnel leh zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou a kipan kik nawn sek ahi, achi hi.
english: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un lungsim kihei in tangbuang leh dawn ding thillat ah vualzawlna nutsiat in a-om kei ding chih kua'n athei a?
english: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to Yahweh, your God.

paite: Zion ah pengkul mut unla, an ngawl hun tang siangthou un, khawmpi taksuaktak bawl un.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.

paite: Mipi kaikhawm unla, omkhawmte hihsiangthou unla, putekte, naupangte, nawitui ne laite kaikhawm unla; mouneite adantan a kipan in hong pawt uhenla, mou leng adantan sunggil a kipan in hong pawt hen.
english: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.

paite: Siampu, TOUPA nasem mite inlim leh maitam kikal ah kap uhenla; TOUPA aw, "Na mite hawi inla, na goutante gensiat a om namte'n atung ua vai ahawmsak ding un pe ke'n; 'A Pathian uh koi a om ahia,' chi in amipite lak ah bangziak a chi ding ahi ua?" chi uhen.
english: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, Yahweh, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”

paite: TOUPA'N agam thikthuse khop in adeihthoh a, amite ahehpih hi.
heading: Toupa'n Gam Avualzawl
english: Then Yahweh was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.

paite: TOUPA'N amite kiang ah, Ngai unla, na kiang uah buhte, uainte, sathaute ka hon tungsak ding a, huaite in na tai ding ua; namte lak ah gensiat in ka hon omsak nawn kei ding.
english: Yahweh answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

paite: Himahleh na kiang ua kipan in mallam sepaihhon ka suanmang ding a, gamkeu leh sia ah ka paisak ding, amasa pawl suahlam tuipi ah, ananung pawl tumlam tuipi ah; ahong uihkhe ding a, namsetak in ahong nam ding, thil thupitak ahih ziak in, chi in adawng hi.
english: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.

paite: Aw gam, lau ke'n, nuam in kipak in; TOUPA'N thil thupite ahihta hi.
english: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.

paite: Gante aw, lau kei un, gamdai loupa mun ahong sel a, sing ahong gah a, theipi kung leh grepgui ahong selpha ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

paite: Nou, Zion tate aw, kipak un, TOUPA na Pathian uah nuam un; noute a ding in vuah azusak a, akha khatna a vuah masa leh vuah nanung ahun lel ahon pe ding hi.
english: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.

paite: Pialkhangte buh in adim ding a, uain leh sathau belte adimlet ding uhi.
english: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

paite: Na lak ua ka sepaihhon tampi ka sawl, khaukhupte, singnget khaute, khauhonte, leh khaupete'n anek khit kumte nou ka hon din nawn ding hi.
english: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.

paite: Tampi na ne ding ua, na tai ding ua, nou lamdangtak a hon ngaihtuah sekpa TOUPA na Pathian min na phat ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei kei uhi.
english: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.

paite: Huan Israelte lak ah ka om chih leh TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih na thei ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei nawn kei ding uhi.
english: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am Yahweh, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.

paite: Huai nung chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sung ding; huchi in na tapate, na tanute un ka thu agen ding ua, na putekte un mang aman ding ua, na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding uh;
heading: TOUPA Kha Sunbuak Chiamna
english: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sikhapate, sikhanute tung ah leng ka kha ka sungbo ding hi.
english: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.

paite: Vante leh leitung ah thillamdangte, sisan, mei leh meikhu ding ka musak ding hi.
english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.

paite: Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding hi, TOUPA ni thupitak leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, kuapeuh TOUPA min lou peuhmah humbit in a-om ding; TOUPA'N agen bang in, Zion tang ah leh Jerusalem khua ah akhosuaksunte a-om ding uhi.
english: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.
